market_name: Will 8 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y/10y Treasury yields and fed funds futures (SOFR strip) have moved in sympathy; if yields are flat, discount the signal.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs MOVE index and any Fed/data headlines to confirm it's rate-driven not idiosyncratic.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess if the Polymarket probability shift persists or mean-reverts; fade if it was a liquidity blip.
time_plan.6h: Review afternoon rates session and any Fed-speak; verify duration bid is holding.
time_plan.12h: Mark TLT return vs entry; log whether the prediction-market move led or lagged the Treasury move.

predictions.reasoning: An 8-cut strike implies ~200bps of 2026 easing — a deeply dovish, recession-flavored outcome. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal markets pricing far more Fed easing than the dot plot, pulling the front end and term structure lower and lifting duration. TLT is the cleanest liquid duration proxy. But the move is noisy: 8 cuts is a tail scenario, usually low probability with thin liquidity, and the signal could reflect crisis-hedging rather than a genuine rate re-pricing.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and real-yield (TIPS) direction to confirm the macro channel is active.
time_plan.1h: Verify gold move is consistent with dollar weakness rather than a safe-haven spike from unrelated risk-off.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether the prediction-market probability holds; weak persistence means fade.
time_plan.6h: Review dollar and rates into US close for confirmation.
time_plan.12h: Mark GLD return and note lead/lag versus the market signal.

predictions.reasoning: A jump in the probability of aggressive Fed cuts implies lower expected real rates and a softer dollar, both tailwinds for gold. Gold also benefits if the dovish repricing reflects recession or crisis fears. However, the linkage is indirect and gold often trades on its own geopolitical/flow drivers, so this is a weaker proxy than Treasuries.

evidence_used: Market strike of 8 cuts (~200bps) represents a deeply dovish, recession-adjacent 2026 scenario well beyond base-case Fed guidance
Rate-cut expectations transmit mechanically to Treasury duration, the dollar, and gold via real rates
Low-probability tail strikes on prediction markets tend to be illiquid and noisy
uncertainty_notes: 8 cuts is a tail outcome; probability moves may be noise or liquidity-driven rather than information
A dovish repricing can be bullish (easing) or bearish (recession) for equities, hence equities excluded as too ambiguous
The 700bps tradable threshold far exceeds realistic 12h moves in these liquid proxies, so these are research signals, not tradable

llm_justification.summary: The 8-cuts-in-2026 market is a tail dovish/recession gauge. A sharp rise in its implied probability would most cleanly imply lower rates (TLT up) and, secondarily, higher gold via lower real rates and a softer dollar. Both mappings are modest-confidence and the expected 12h magnitudes fall well short of the 700bps tradable bar, so these are noisy research observations rather than actionable trades.
key_assumptions: A probability shift in this market reflects genuine rate-expectation repricing, not idiosyncratic noise
The Fed rate channel transmits to Treasuries, dollar, and gold in the standard direction
No overriding risk-off or geopolitical shock dominates these proxies in the window
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is an illiquid blip that mean-reverts within hours
The dovish signal already reflects public data (CPI/jobs), so proxies have priced it and don't move
Gold/Treasuries driven by unrelated flows, making the proxy exposure weak
A recession interpretation hits equities while rates rally less than expected, breaking the clean duration thesis
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
